meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

copy.tagline: 在对话中隐藏注入工作模式指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在特定提示下自动切换工作模式
copy.tagline_en: Inject a hidden work mode directive when a prompt contains ultrawork
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically switch work mode based on specific prompts

howto.what: Claude 会进入严谨工作模式:回复开头会显示“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,然后先写下目标和计划,用测试先证明问题存在、再修到通过,并实际用浏览器、命令行等真实环境验证做好的功能真的能用,最后交付有证据的结果。
howto.when: 当你说的话里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发,本次对话按该模式工作。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式帮我修这个问题,确保修好并给我验证证据。
say.note: 它会先写计划、跑失败测试,再给出真实验证证据。

say.text: 以 ulw 模式实现登录接口,先用测试证明失败再修到通过。
say.note: 涉及登录接口属于重任务,会走完整验证流程。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork,完成这个新页面,并在真实浏览器里验证效果。
say.note: 对应浏览器验证通道,会截取真实页面截图作为证据。

howto.what_en: Enables a rigorous work mode: Claude first writes a goal and a plan, proves the bug with a failing test, then makes it pass, and verifies the delivered feature on the real surface (browser, terminal, HTTP) with captured evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user's prompt contains “ultrawork” or “ulw”; the directive is injected and the mode takes effect for the conversation.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in ultrawork mode and show me the proof.
say_en.note: Writes failing tests first, then verifies the real surface.

say_en.text: Implement the login API in ulw mode; prove it with a failing test first.
say_en.note: Login API is HEAVY; full verification flow runs.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork and build this new page, then verify it in a real browser.
say_en.note: Uses the browser QA channel for real-page evidence.
